# Retail CoD UO 1.51b dedicated server playerstate along a walked route, per usercmd.
# map mp_carentan, g_gametype dm, joined allies, weapon mg30cal_mp, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults, one client on the server.
# Captured with COD_VERSION=uo tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_moveshot mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1
# +set probe_spot wall and --net-probe --save-slope --probe-moveshot bipod --probe-cmd-ms 8:
# moveshot_script(bipod) from the placement, facing world yaw 0. !cmd is a
# usercmd as it went on the wire (angles already rebased on delta_angles),
# !snap the playerstate the next snapshot carried, with ct its commandTime.
# Floats are printed exactly; step lists the EV_STEP_VIEW parms the snapshot
# brought, minus the 128 bias, and ev every event:parm it brought; wire is
# every non-zero netfield as decoded (pm_flags in 1.1's layout), ammo and clip
# the non-zero slots. The cmds ahead of the first !snap went out before it.
# imp, where present, is every bullet-impact temp entity the snapshot carried
# as entnum:x,y,z, ;-separated; one impact rides several snapshots.
# Tagged moveshot-bipodpoint-uo, 2026-11-14, inside `unshare -rn`, with --probe-team allies --probe-weapon mg30cal_mp
# and +set probe_block 17 +set probe_block_z -13 +set probe_block_bare 1 (a bare script model at (1988, 1930, -13), setContents(1)),
# on a server whose COD_LNXDED_HOME held uo/weapons/mp/mg30cal_mp with crates/server/tests/common/mod.rs STEADY_WEAPON applied,
# under gdb (a breakpoint past CalcMuzzlePoint's trap_Trace, cod11-combat.md 2.1); moveshot_ab.rs replays it on ours.
# cmd_ms 8
